applicabilityBasis.summary: WTGXX represents shares of the WisdomTree Treasury Money Market Digital Fund, an SEC-registered open-end mutual fund under the Investment Company Act of 1940 that operates as a government money market fund under Rule 2a-7. The issuer factsheet identifies its tokens as digital representations of fund shares. GENIUS Act section 2(22)(B)(iii) excludes securities from the payment-stablecoin definition. WisdomTree markets the fund as a possible reserve investment for payment-stablecoin issuers; that positioning does not constitute GENIUS issuer authorization.

genius.notes: WTGXX is an SEC-registered money-market-fund security excluded by GENIUS Act section 2(22)(B)(iii). Its token represents fund shares with a targeted, non-guaranteed $1 NAV. Registration is under the Investment Company Act of 1940; Rule 2a-7 governs the money market fund. WisdomTree announced a November 1, 2025 strategy change intended to support use as a reserve investment, and the current prospectus specifies the intended eligible-reserve strategy. This issuer positioning does not establish GENIUS issuer authorization. The reserve-disclosure flag records public fund portfolio information, not payment-stablecoin reserve compliance. The prospectus publishes purchase and redemption procedures at the next calculated NAV through WisdomTree Prime or WisdomTree Connect; this is a fund-share redemption policy, without a guaranteed fixed-value payment-stablecoin redemption promise. Monthly fund reporting does not establish a monthly payment-stablecoin reserve attestation. No broad enforcement finding is asserted.
